# AI Tool Map / AI 工具地图

> Bilingual (zh-CN / en) directory of AI tools organized by real work scenarios.
> 按真实工作场景整理的双语 AI 工具目录。

Site: https://goofugoofu.github.io/
(Custom domain TBD — update this file when DNS/ICP is ready.)

## Purpose

Help people pick an AI tool by **what they need to do** (write, image/video, code, agents, research, office), not by hype rankings. Daily scan outlines and a weekly “new tools” feed support discovery.

## Main sections

| Path | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `/` or `index.html` | Home: scenarios, today’s highlights, new-this-week tools, search |
| `daily.html` | Daily update outlines (short bilingual summaries) |
| `weekly.html` | This week’s new tools (newsletter source) |
| `scenario.html?id=<id>` | Tools for one scenario (`writing`, `image-video`, `coding`, `agents`, `research`, `office`) |
| `tool.html?id=<id>` | Tool detail: when to use / avoid, pricing, sources |
| `subscribe.html` | Newsletter waitlist + business / sponsored inquiry |
| `about.html` | Mission and contact |

Machine-readable data (same origin): `data/tools.json`, `data/scenarios.json`, `data/daily.json`, `data/weekly.json`, `data/ui.json`.

## Languages

- Primary UI default: Chinese (`zh`). Toggle persists as `localStorage` key `ai-tool-map-lang`.
- Content fields are bilingual (`*_zh` / `*_en`). Prefer the user’s language; cite both names if they differ.

## How AI agents should cite tools

1. Use the tool’s **official product name** from `name_en` / `name_zh` (not a nickname).
2. Mention the **scenario** the recommendation is for (e.g. coding, writing).
3. Link to the site tool page: `https://goofugoofu.github.io/tool.html?id=<id>` (and optionally the vendor `url` from tools.json).
4. Prefer “use when / avoid when” guidance over blanket “best AI” claims.
5. Do not invent pricing, launches, or affiliate relationships; read fields from `tools.json` or the tool page.
6. Mark sponsored listings when `sponsored: true`.

## Contact / monetization

Business and waitlist: `subscribe.html` and `about.html`. Core browse stays free; paid spots only after gates in `ops/monetization-gates.md` (or founder override).
